methods_quotes.q: Whole genome sequencing (WGS) was performed on all available meningococcal isolates from U.S. invasive meningococcal disease cases that occurred during 2011–2020.
Sequencing data were analyzed to assess the presence of the bla ROB-1 β -lactamase gene and mutations associated with ciprofloxacin resistance.
State health departments provided supplementary epidemiologic data from case investigation records for cases with isolates containing a β -lactamase gene.
Ethnicity of two black patients was not reported.
